body:
Closes #6562. Closes #6567.

A reduction over a reduced field on an immersed `TripolarGrid` built the mask of the immersed columns twice on the rank of the north fold, because only that rank wrapped its condition in `PrognosticTripolarCells`. The second mask allocates a distributed field that the other ranks do not, the field tags diverge, and later halo exchanges never complete.

- Every rank now wraps the condition in `PrognosticTripolarCells`; the predicate keeps every cell where the local y-topology has no fold.
- `immersed_reduced_tripolar_condition_operand` builds the `ConditionalOperation` directly, so the immersed columns are masked once.
- The fold rank of a distributed `FaceFolded` grid now gets the `FaceFolded` mask (it got the `CenterFolded` one because its south side is not `Closed`).
- New distributed test, for the three fold topologies: the field tags are equal on every rank, and `sum(c; dims=(1, 2))`, `Average(c, dims=(1, 2))` and `sum(v)` match a serial grid.
